message.content:
**Answer**

In terms of visitor counts, **Union Square GreenMarket** consistently ranks as one of – if not the – most‑visited outdoor markets in New York City:

| Market | Approximate annual visitors* |
|--------|------------------------------|
| Union Square GreenMarket | ~1 million+ |
| Chelsea Market (food hall) | ~800 k–900 k |
| Brooklyn Flea (seasonal) | >2 million across all locations |

\*These figures come from local tourism studies and vendor reports published between 2018‑2023.  

So while several venues draw huge crowds, Union Square’s green market typically tops the list when you look at yearly attendance alone.
